alt: Hand-sketched isometric of the two V2 private saunas on the 18 x 36 ft float, from the Rev AH coordination set: black metal shed roofs with stovepipes, the 6 ft front fence, the privacy wall on the center line, the East round window and zen deck with the bonsai garden.
caption: Four layers pulled apart: platform and tile, interior, walls, roof. Dashed outline between the rooms is the future cold plunge. Dashed line inside the walls is the flat ceiling at 7 ft to 7 ft 4 in that we are asking Grant for. Door, window and stove positions are schematic until Grant's CAD is final.

key.d: Both rooms sit on one platform west of the extension dock, on TC Diving floats.
The enclosed court between the rooms, lockable gate now.
89 x 113 in per room, about 155 sq ft ordered for both.
On-site cedar, decided 10/16. Upper bench drawn 4 ft deep, lower bench 16 in.
21 in x 12 in. Needs 12 in clearance on three sides and a guard: two rails 8 in apart, top rail 28 in off the floor.
Fiber cement about 2 ft wide, floor to ceiling, behind the stove.
Rough opening 27.5 x 83.5 in. Shorter on purpose to hold heat, with a heat shield above.
60 in round window facing the mountain.
Near-floor-to-ceiling 40 in glass on two adjacent sides.
Dashed seams mean not on yet. Cameron (father and son) roofs it, about $9.6K bundled with the ADU.
Double-wall inside, 6 in DuraTech above the roof. One per room.

layers.d: Tile order is placed from the 10/15 math.
layers.label: tile pending

layers.d: Cedar benches, stove, guard, fiber cement.
Framing done, exterior T&G going up.
Sheathed. Ceiling T&G, stovepipes, metal roof, siding in that order.

notes: Rev 05: five views drawn over the newest coordination set model (Rev AH, 10/22), to scale. Nothing added by hand.
New since last sketch: West stove-side window to the floor (AE), fire pit gas stubs on each private deck (AF), stove corner finish picked (AG). Build status unchanged from the 10/15 walk.
Still open: Torch has to OK 6 in clearance and the floor-level glass for the TS-85F in writing; Grant to tape the stove collar height.
foot: Source: Assets/V2 Build Drawings/, newest Coordination Set · redrawn every Saturday morning
